name: list_schemas
description: List all schemas in the database

name: get_object_details
description: Show detailed information about a database object: columns, constraints, and indexes of a table or view

name: execute_sql
description: Execute any SQL query, including writes, against the database

name: explain_query
description: Explains the execution plan for a SQL query, showing how the database will execute it and provides detailed cost estimates.

analyze.description: When True, actually runs the query to show real execution statistics instead of estimates.

hypothetical_indexes.description: A list of hypothetical indexes to simulate.

name: analyze_workload_indexes
description: Analyze frequently executed queries in the database and recommend optimal indexes

name: analyze_query_indexes
description: Analyze a list of (up to 10) SQL queries and recommend optimal indexes

queries.description: List of Query strings to analyze

name: analyze_db_health
description: Analyzes database health. Checks index health, connection utilization, vacuum health, sequence limits, replication lag, buffer cache hit rate, and constraint validation.

health_type.description: Health checks to run: index, connection, vacuum, sequence, replication, buffer, constraint, all

name: get_top_queries
description: Reports the slowest or most resource-intensive queries using data from the 'pg_stat_statements' extension.
